mapper.select: select a.* from HR_SALARY_STANDARD a left join HR_SALARY_PAY b on a.ID = b.STANDARD_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.TYPE = #{type} where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.TYPE='月工资标准' and a.`YEAR_MONTH` = #{yearMonth} and a.HAVE_SENIORITY_PAY = '是' and a.POSITIVE_TIME is not null and b.ID is null

select a.*, b.`YEAR_MONTH` as yearMonth,b.ID_CARD_NUMBER as idCardNumber,b.USER_NAME as userName,b.COMPANY as company, b.FIRST_ORG_NAME as firstOrgName,b.ORG_NAME as orgName,b.HIRE_DATE as hireDate,b.LEAVE_DATE as leaveDate, b.POSITIVE_TIME as positiveTime,b.BIRTH_DAY as birthDay,b.STANDARD_AMOUNT as standardAmount,b.USER_TYPE as userType from HR_SALARY_PAY a left join HR_SALARY_STANDARD b on a.STANDARD_ID = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.*, b.`YEAR_MONTH` as yearMonth,b.ID_CARD_NUMBER as idCardNumber,b.USER_NAME as userName,b.COMPANY as company, b.FIRST_ORG_NAME as firstOrgName,b.ORG_NAME as orgName,b.HIRE_DATE as hireDate,b.LEAVE_DATE as leaveDate, b.POSITIVE_TIME as positiveTime,b.BIRTH_DAY as birthDay,b.STANDARD_AMOUNT as standardAmount,b.USER_TYPE as userType from HR_SALARY_PAY a left join HR_SALARY_STANDARD b on a.STANDARD_ID = b.ID where a.ID = #{id}
